t: The Milwaukee M12 B2 12V 2.0Ah Li-Ion RedLithium battery provides reliable power for cordless tools. It is ideal for electricians and plumbers working on site, ensuring consistent performance throughout the workday. Integrated welded frame construction with shock-responsive separators prevents pack failure from excessive vibrations or drops, enhancing durability. Individual cell monitoring ensures optimal charge and discharge, maximising battery life. Provides dependable power for various trade applications. Compatible with all Milwaukee M12 cordless power tools.
